summary: Capture helper missed the field nickname prompt and entered the editor
symptom: Togedemaru received Aaaaaaaaaa because post-capture cleanup searched battle printers only, pressed A at the field nickname prompt, and continued through the editor

unexpected.predicted: Post-capture cleanup requires an explicit nickname, enters the naming screen once, and verifies the inserted party/storage name
unexpected.actual: The prompt was present in text.current but absent from battle_printers, so the helper pressed A and typed repeated A characters
diff: prompt source was field text.current, while the detector inspected battle_printers only

authority.oracle: Field text-printer RAM plus captured Pokémon nickname from decrypted party/storage RAM

reproduction.observed: Both runs inserted species 878 as Copperpot and returned clean overworld

hypotheses.claim: Naming-screen field mode 10 is the authoritative fallback when prompt text is no longer active
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: Typing only on mode 10 yields the requested decrypted nickname
hypotheses.evidence_for: Two party insertions and one full-party PC insertion verified requested names

root_cause.claim: The cleanup controller relied on battle-printer prompt text and lacked an authoritative naming-screen mode branch, so its generic A fallback became character input
evidence: Mode-10 controller produced Copperpot twice and Ohmnomnom in full PC storage
alternatives_falsified: Keyboard path error: Center and capture flows now share the same verified typer
Storage decoder error: personality/species/name were read from decrypted inserted records

solution.contract_change: Every capture requires a fitting nickname; field mode 10 invokes the shared typer exactly once and success requires the inserted RAM record to match

targeted_checks.name: named party and PC capture replays
targeted_checks.command: disposable clone named Cufant twice plus full-party Togedemaru once
targeted_checks.evidence: Copperpot twice; Ohmnomnom stored as species 777

replay.expected: One named party insertion with unchanged target species and clean overworld
replay.actual: Both fixed-fixture runs inserted Copperpot species 878 and returned overworld

regression_cases: nickname prompt present only in text.current
tooling_contracts: Capture is blocked without a chosen fitting nickname; success requires exact inserted-record name verification
